name: sqlite-3.27-automatic-index
query:
SELECT p.category, count(*) AS items
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.price = oi.unit_price
WHERE oi.order_id < 2000
GROUP BY p.category
rows: SEARCH TABLE order_items AS oi USING INDEX order_items_order_id_idx (order_id<?)
SEARCH TABLE products AS p USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (price=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
